title: pouteria benai
intro: Pouteria benai, commonly known as the Benai tree, is a plant species within the family Sapotaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and alleviating respiratory issues. The health benefits of Pouteria benai include its antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are associated with its therapeutic actions of relieving pain, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria benai include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
